strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Disk Structure Wipe via Boot/Partition Overwrite

analytics.name: Analytic 0827
analytics.guidance: Processes attempting raw disk access to overwrite sensitive structures such as the MBR or partition table using \\.\PhysicalDrive notation. Detection relies on correlating process creation, privilege escalation, and raw sector writes in Sysmon and Security logs.

tuning.description: Specify which sectors are considered critical (MBR, partition table) to reduce noise.
Exclude legitimate low-level disk management or imaging tools used by administrators.

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
log_sources.channel: Raw write attempts targeting \\.\PhysicalDrive0 or sector 0 (MBR/partition table)

analytics.name: Analytic 0828
analytics.guidance: Execution of utilities (dd, hdparm, sgdisk) or custom binaries attempting to overwrite disk boot structures (/dev/sda MBR sector or partition tables). Detection correlates shell execution with syscalls writing to sector 0 or disk metadata blocks.

tuning.description: Define specific device paths to monitor (e.g., /dev/sda, /dev/nvme0n1).
Focus on suspicious writes at disk offsets corresponding to MBR/partition structures.

log_sources.name: auditd:EXECVE
log_sources.channel: Execution of dd/sgdisk with arguments writing to sector 0 or partition table

analytics.name: Analytic 0829
analytics.guidance: Abnormal invocation of diskutil or asr that modifies partition tables or initializes raw devices. Monitor for IOKit system calls targeting disk headers or EFI boot sectors, correlated with elevated privileges.

tuning.description: System provisioning workflows may legitimately re-partition disks; whitelist by context.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: diskutil partitionDisk or eraseVolume with partition scheme modifications

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: IOKit raw disk write to EFI/boot partition sectors

analytics.name: Analytic 0830
analytics.guidance: Execution of destructive CLI commands such as format flash:, format disk, or equivalent vendor-specific commands that erase filesystem structures. Detection correlates AAA logs showing privileged access with immediate format/erase commands.

tuning.description: Expand detection to cover vendor-specific destructive commands.
Whitelist authorized maintenance sessions to reduce false positives.

log_sources.name: networkdevice:cli
log_sources.channel: format flash:, format disk, reformat commands

log_sources.name: networkdevice:syslog
log_sources.channel: Privileged login followed by destructive format command
